claim: Windows runInstall/writeInstallEnv overwrites install.env without reading it, so a plain reinstall resets a profile's customized ports to the shared defaults; install.sh preserves them.
fix: Read the existing install.env first (mirroring install.sh's ENV_CONFIGSERVER_PORT/ENV_PEEK_PORT/ENV_PEEK_CONTROL_PORT fallback chain) before writeInstallEnv writes a new one, so a reinstall without explicit overrides preserves the profile's previously resolved ports instead of resetting to shared defaults.

claim: railroad-review v8.4 invokes lanes bare with full context injection, contradicting spec-7's correctness-58 (--no-context lane invocation) with no recorded decision superseding it.
fix: Either restore the --no-context lane invocation (SKILL.md CTX-002 and workflows/railroad-review.js lanePrompt), or record an explicit decision/errata superseding spec-7's correctness-58 that cites the v8.4 rationale.

claim: smine-permissions step 2 family-merges observed Bash grants by dropping trailing tokens with no guard for programs whose second token is a target rather than a subcommand, auto-deriving rules like Bash(ssh prod-host *) — unreviewed remote command execution.
fix: In step 2 (candidate→rule), keep every argument token literal unless the program is on a known-safe subcommand allowlist (git, gh, go, make, npm, …); otherwise emit a fully literal rule or route the candidate to human instead of auto-deriving a wildcard.

claim: smine-batch captures prompted-and-granted command strings verbatim into session JSON and permissions-proposal evidence, neither gitignored nor redacted, so credentials in command lines land in git history.
fix: Redact common credential shapes (Bearer/API tokens, basic-auth userinfo in URLs, secret-named env assignments) in captured command strings before they are written to the batch JSON or copied into permissions-proposal evidence, or keep only program+subcommand.

claim: The global ask-floor for Edit/Write on **/*.acdsl and acdsl/** was removed; acdsl-policy-guard.sh only denies under mode strict and fails open for gated/free/missing policy, which is this repo's own configuration.
fix: Keep a conservative global ask-rule for *.acdsl/acdsl/** as a floor, or make acdsl-policy-guard.sh fail closed when acdsl/policy.json is missing/unreadable and add a deny/ask branch for gated mode.

claim: startPeek's reuse-match ignores the decoded ControlPort, so a stale peek listener on a different control port is reused while dashboardURL points at the newly configured port.
fix: Add `&& id.ControlPort == controlPort` to startPeek's reuse-match condition so a control-port mismatch is logged and disabled like a home-dir mismatch.

claim: install.ps1 treats shellcheck as a hard dependency in $missing, aborting the whole install when winget is absent or declined; spec-9 and install.sh make it warn-only.
fix: Check shellcheck.exe separately from git/go/jq and only print a WARN with the winget hint instead of adding it to $missing.

claim: The Trim stage counts and trims only proposals/{routines,context,skills}.json although smine-permissions was added to PROPOSAL_DIMENSIONS, so permissions proposals escape --max-proposals-mined.
fix: Add proposals/permissions.json to the Trim stage prompt's file set and count/removal logic in session-mine.js (~line 176).

claim: worktreeSessions was inserted before rootCause, breaking alphabetical free-function order and orphaning rootCause's doc comment.
fix: Move worktreeSessions (with its own doc comment) after rootCause, reattaching rootCause's doc comment to rootCause.

claim: Single-line exec.CommandContext call with six arguments and a nested call exceeds the multiline threshold.
fix: Break the exec.CommandContext(...) call onto multiple lines, one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: Single-line shell.Run call with nine arguments and a nested call exceeds the multiline threshold.
fix: Break the shell.Run(...) call onto multiple lines, one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: RunSync duplicates Run's body verbatim apart from the timeout and error prefix.
fix: Extract an unexported runWithTimeout(ctx, timeout, prefix, dir, name, args...) helper that Run and RunSync both call.

claim: The new build-install target carries a '## build:' help label, colliding with the real build target's row in make help.
fix: Change the comment to `## build-install: build all binaries and install`.

claim: The skill-override strip jq program is repeated byte-identically for $SETTINGS_FILE and $REPO_LOCAL_SETTINGS.
fix: Extract a strip_skill_overrides <file> function holding the jq filter and call it for both files.

claim: Presentation-profile read and dev-mode derivation are duplicated between cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:55-66 and routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:25-45.
fix: Factor the presentation-profile read and dev-mode derivation into a shared routines/_lib/presentation.sh sourced by both wrappers (nightly copy is at lines 25-45).

claim: subsystem-grounding.js is never invoked by fdesign/SKILL.md nor documented in skills/README.md, yet changelog v3.7 claims it is active — dead code with a false changelog entry.
fix: Wire an explicit Workflow invocation into fdesign/SKILL.md's Ground phase and add it to skills/README.md's Workflows section, or drop the file and its changelog claim.

claim: smine-permissions declares version 0.1.0, the only three-part version among skills; the repo uses major.minor.
fix: Set version to 0.1 in SKILL.md and changelog.json[0].version.

claim: handleRoutineDetail's spec-11 week-band rendering has no server-side test.
fix: Add internal/server/routines_test.go that GETs /routines/{name} for a routine with multi-week run history and asserts data-stamp="<RFC3339>" and the run-band script marker.

claim: TestReposDelete lacks spec-14's cross-instance subtest with a second repos.NewRegistry on the same path.
fix: Add a TestReposDelete subtest that deletes via the server, then opens repos.NewRegistry(reposPath) + Reload() and asserts the repo is absent.

claim: New LoadFragment has no unit test for its missing-file and malformed-JSON-after-expansion branches.
fix: Add TestLoadFragment in internal/config covering missing-file and malformed-JSON-after-expansion, mirroring Load's cases.

claim: SyncAll's new NotFound+DefaultDisabled skip branch on Windows has no test.
fix: Add a windows-build-tagged test covering SyncAll's NotFound+DefaultDisabled skip branch.

claim: Bootstrap log opened at a fixed path in the shared temp dir with 0o644 and no O_EXCL — world-readable and pre-creatable by another local user.
fix: Create the log with os.CreateTemp (unique per-run name, 0o600) or under the user's own state dir with 0o600.

claim: fmt.Errorf message lacks the Component.Method: prefix and starts lowercase.
fix: Use fmt.Errorf("Server.handleProfileSave: Skills sync after audience change failed: %w", err).

claim: peekID fields are not in alphabetical order.
fix: Reorder peekID's fields: ClaudeHome, CodexHome, ControlPort, Version.

claim: config-ui-fidelity-gate.js is documented in docs/workflows.md as fronted by /fimplement but fimplement/SKILL.md never invokes it.
fix: Wire an explicit invocation into fimplement/SKILL.md's Phase 4 — Commit and mirror it in skills/README.md's Workflows section, or drop the file.

claim: foreign-toolchain-pretag.js is documented as fronted by /package-commit but package-commit/SKILL.md never invokes it.
fix: Wire an explicit invocation into package-commit/SKILL.md before a release tag and mirror it in skills/README.md's Workflows section, or drop the file.

claim: Step 8 packs a 9-item outcome enumeration into one inline code span, over the 6-item cap.
fix: Move the outcome enumeration out of the inline code span into a list or table.

claim: spec-8 names a TestRepoValidate test that does not exist; its cases live under TestRegistryAdd's reserved-name subtest.
fix: Lift the reserved-name cases from TestRegistryAdd into a TestRepoValidate function in registry_test.go so the spec-named test exists.

claim: routine_worktree_create's post-sync HEAD-off-branch discard guard is untested.
fix: Add a case to cmd/tests/test_routine_worktree.sh that stubs routine_chain_sync_main to leave HEAD off the dated branch and asserts the worktree/branch is discarded and the call returns non-zero.

claim: Repo.Validate does not reject Name '.' or '..', unlike sessions.validateScopeName; no current path sink consumes Name.
fix: Reject Name == "." and Name == ".." in Repo.Validate, mirroring sessions.validateScopeName.

claim: policyBase lets Policy.BaseRef from the branch's own working acdsl/policy.json pick the commit CheckPolicy treats as the trust anchor; base_ref="HEAD" makes merge-base(HEAD,HEAD)=HEAD, so the branch diffs the self-management surface against itself and can self-escalate (e.g. to mode free) with zero ACDSL-POLICY diagnostics, defeating the branch-topology privilege boundary.
fix: In policyBase, resolve the candidate chain (origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master) unconditionally first; honor base_ref only when read from that resolved base commit's acdsl/policy.json (via GitShowFile), never from the working/HEAD policy; additionally reject a resolved base equal to HEAD's own commit on a non-base branch. Add a policy_test.go case with base_ref="HEAD" on a branch asserting the surface change is still flagged.

claim: The allow rules Bash(git * branch*), Bash(git * log*), Bash(git * show*), Bash(git * status*) put a wildcard between git and the subcommand, so `git -c core.pager=<cmd> log` matches and runs an arbitrary command with no prompt. The rules are pre-existing (lines 21-25 unchanged in this range) but ship in the template this diff modifies.
fix: Replace the four `Bash(git * <sub>*)` rules (settings.json:21-23,25) with subcommand-anchored forms (`Bash(git branch*)`, `Bash(git show*)`; `git log*`/`git status*` already exist at :30/:34) and drop `Bash(git * stash list)` in favor of `Bash(git stash list)`; the `-C <dir>` use these rules served must then be covered by an explicit form that cannot carry `-c` (author decides: anchored `Bash(git -C * log*)` still admits `-C x -c ...`, so prefer a PreToolUse hook that refuses git global options other than -C, mirroring the toolpolicy gate).

claim: The casual-lockout gate only covers edits to existing skills; new-skill creation is exempt and smine-apply stamps every pipeline-created skill origin: user, so under auto-apply always/decide a skill mined from untrusted transcript prose becomes a trusted, lockout-exempt skill with no human vote.
fix: In smine-skills/SKILL.md:45 and smine-apply/SKILL.md steps 4-5, subject new-skill proposals to the same casual-lockout gate as edits (never auto-applied on a casual install; explicit human + vote by id required), and stop auto-stamping origin: user on pipeline-created skills — stamp it only on a human-voted apply.

claim: stateNoteFor appends hardcoded English action suffixes ("click to filter this set" / "click to clear the filter") to translated vote-tooltip counts, so German installs render mixed-language tooltips.
fix: Thread `language` from groupViews into stateNoteFor, wrap both action literals in translate(language, ...), and add their German strings to germanCatalog in internal/server/i18n.go.

claim: docs/workflows.md still documents railroad-review lane/refuter/station/cleanup branches under the retired claude/railroad-* prefix while the skill moved to claude-review/*.
fix: Rewrite docs/workflows.md:65's four branch patterns and the cleanup glob to the claude-review/* names used by skills/quality/railroad-review/workflows/railroad-review.js.

claim: ACDSL-JSON-002 still anchors only sessions/(personal|work)/json/*.json; new per-repo batch JSON lands outside the anchor and empty="ok" hides that the schema gate now covers nothing new.
fix: Change the ACDSL-JSON-002 anchor to an RE2-valid per-repo form such as `^sessions/[^/]+/json/.*\.json$` (the lane's `(?!archived/)` lookahead is not supported by Go regexp); acdsl/ is the self-management surface, so the change lands via the base branch.

claim: The release build downloads jq.exe and peek-mcp.exe with curl and no checksum, then bundles them into the Windows installer unverified.
fix: After each curl -fsSL -o in ci.yml:51-52, verify the file against a recorded SHA-256 (e.g. `echo "<sha256>  dist/jq.exe" | sha256sum -c -`) and fail the step on mismatch, before upload to windows-payload.

claim: install.sh --serena runs `uv tool install --upgrade serena-agent` unpinned, pulling the newest PyPI release on every install and running it as an MCP server.
fix: Pin to an explicit release: `uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent==<version>` (drop --upgrade), matching the pinned peek-mcp@v1.2.2 install at install.sh:64.

claim: New booleans bootstrapRun.running, repos.go's cached/worktreeStatusPage.Cached and profilesettings.go's audienceChanged do not read as predicates.
fix: Rename bootstrapRun.running -> isRunning (and its getter), repos.go's cached / worktreeStatusPage.Cached -> isCached / IsCached (update the template reference), profilesettings.go's audienceChanged -> isAudienceChanged.

claim: Bare field-label comments (`// since`, `// extra-prompt`, `// audience`, `// language`) in non-test, non-Validate functions.
fix: Delete the bare `// since` / `// extra-prompt` comments in bootstrapEnv (bootstrap.go:179,188) and `// audience` / `// language` in handleProfileSave (profilesettings.go:71,78).

claim: The startPeek call grew to 7 arguments and stayed on one line.
fix: Break the startPeek(...) call at main.go:128 onto multiple lines, one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: peekIdentity's new error omits the Component.Method: prefix.
fix: Change to fmt.Errorf("peekIdentity: healthz status %d", resp.StatusCode).

claim: New type peekID uses ALL-CAPS ID instead of the repo's mandated Id casing.
fix: Rename peekID to peekId (type declaration, peekIdentity's return type, and the `var id peekID` declaration).

claim: Fingerprint's two shell.Run calls carry 7 and 6 arguments on single lines.
fix: Break both shell.Run(...) calls in Fingerprint (registry.go:462,467) onto multiple lines, one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: New Registry fields loadedModTime/loadedSize were inserted after mu, breaking alphabetical field order.
fix: Reorder Registry's unexported fields to loadedModTime, loadedSize, mu, repos, keeping mu's doc comment attached to mu.

claim: refreshIfChanged inlines a condition with two && operators.
fix: Extract `isUnchanged := err == nil && info.ModTime().Equal(modTime) && info.Size() == size` and test `if isUnchanged { return }`, as line 95 already does for its own guard.

claim: New runWithTimeout orders its parameters timeout, prefix, dir, name instead of alphabetically.
fix: Reorder to runWithTimeout(ctx context.Context, dir, name, prefix string, timeout time.Duration, args ...string) and update the Run and RunSync call sites.

claim: Run's and RunSync's runWithTimeout calls carry 6 arguments on single lines.
fix: Break both `return runWithTimeout(...)` calls (shell.go:52,58) onto multiple lines, one argument per line with a trailing comma (apply together with code-style-MIN-25-r2's reorder).

claim: The Disposition ledger bullet now lists 7 inline outcome values, over the 6-item inline cap.
fix: Move the Disposition ledger bullet's 7 outcome values into a fenced one-per-line list, as step 8 of the same file already does.

claim: New profileTestAnswer and styleTestTarget have no tests although both are pure and branchy.
fix: Add table-driven tests in profilesettings_test.go for profileTestAnswer (malformed envelope, is_error, success) and styleTestTarget (no smine-nightly routine, ROUTINE_MODEL override, ROUTINE_TOKEN file present vs missing), following TestServer_CheckPeekFragment's pattern; the live claude -p call stays untested.

claim: routineSession's new prefix-match over two roots plus latest-wins selection is untested.
fix: Add a routineSession table test in routines_test.go: group-worktree-only match, `<group>-cells/` match, and two candidates where the more recently active session wins.

claim: New handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus and resolveBootstrapSession have no tests.
fix: Point the server's peek client at newStubPeek (sessions_test.go) and add a handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus test asserting pid==0 renders "no bootstrap run yet" and that resolveBootstrapSession picks the session whose cwd equals the repo root and whose LastActive is within the startedAt window.

claim: Repo.Validate's traversal guard for Name "."/".." has no TestRepoValidate case.
fix: Add a "traversal-name-fails" case to TestRepoValidate covering Name "." and "..", asserting Validate() errors.

claim: SyncAll's new DefaultDisabled skip branch on darwin has no test, unlike its Windows twin.
fix: Add internal/routines/bootstrap_darwin_test.go mirroring TestSyncAllSkipsDefaultDisabledNotFoundTask: stub launchctl, mark a routine DefaultDisabled with no "enabled" override, call SyncAll, assert bootstrap/start never fires.

claim: New PreToolUse hook acdsl-policy-guard.sh has no test suite while its sibling hooks each got one.
fix: Add cmd/tests/test_acdsl_policy_guard.sh on test_skill_invoke_gate.sh's harness: synthetic PreToolUse JSON against free/gated/strict policy.json fixtures, asserting deny-with-reason for the self-management surface and for *.acdsl / acdsl/* in strict mode, silent allow otherwise.

claim: test_squash_transfer_reads_contained asserts only `squashed:` instead of spec-11's required `squashed:2`.
fix: Change `grep -q 'squashed:'` to `grep -q 'squashed:2'` in test_squash_transfer_reads_contained.

claim: TestWorktreeSessionsPrefersBranchOverRecycledDir's t.Run body declares two locals before its assert.
fix: Store the []repos.WorktreeStatus slice as a testCase field so the t.Run body is a flat call-and-assert with zero declarations.

claim: handleWelcomeBootstrap passes the os.CreateTemp error bare while wrapping the cmd.Start error in the same function.
fix: Wrap as respond.WithInternalServerError(fmt.Errorf("handleWelcomeBootstrap: Failed to create log file: %w", err), w), matching line 97.

claim: config-ui-fidelity-gate.js omits the '// ---- Stage ... ----' banners its sibling workflow files use before each phase() call.
fix: Add `// ---- Stage Render: ... ----` above phase('Render') at line 50 and `// ---- Stage Gate: ... ----` above phase('Gate') at line 73.

claim: After a failed Reload, refreshIfChanged never records the bad file's identity, so a malformed repos.json is re-read, re-parsed and re-logged on every Find()/Repos() call.
fix: On a failed Reload in refreshIfChanged, record the failed file's mtime/size (e.g. failedModTime/failedSize) and skip reloading until the identity changes again.

claim: TestFolderDialogScript does not pin the $owner.Show()/$owner.Activate() foreground fix.
fix: Add assert.Contains(t, folderDialogScript, "$owner.Show()") and assert.Contains(t, folderDialogScript, "$owner.Activate()") to TestFolderDialogScript in sync_test.go.
